notes: Fixed periodic baselines only; no RL training or policy fitting.
Pure P&L is final wealth minus initial capital; fees and gas included, no inventory penalty.
External paths match across widths within each volatility.
The same seed, path count and step count give the same normal price shocks across volatilities.
Trade arrivals and pool prices remain endogenous to each baseline and volatility.
The episode horizon and rebalance cadence are unchanged.
Other P&L is an accounting residual, including inventory and reinvestment valuation effects.
